modules.title: Beltloader brake checks
modules.inputs: GM aircraft/doors/BL/obstacles; BL tracks with optical-flow points, movement state and identity; view configuration.
modules.outputs: One Pass/Fail/Not observed result plus report/timeline; any failed eligible loader causes failure.
modules.attention: Do not replace its recomputed status with generic tracker status without replay comparison; seconds vary with configured FPS.

modules.title: Aircraft wheel chocks
modules.inputs: Pixels; GM chocks, wheels, nose/aircraft, pushback/towbar, cones and transport; worker/GSE/BL/aircraft tracks.
modules.outputs: THREE policy results in order: front_placed, main gear, front_removed, with parallel reports/timelines.
modules.attention: Front-removed success includes sustained chock presence after attachment; this is ordering evidence, not an explicit removal-edge detector. Preserve multiple task IDs instead of flattening the repository to one result.

modules.title: Cargo-door opening evidence
modules.inputs: GM front/back door, main aircraft and transport/obstacles; aircraft motion state and camera view.
modules.outputs: One result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Does not verify a BL target-door relationship or independently distinguish mechanical open/closed state beyond detector-label semantics.

modules.title: Beltloader chocks
modules.inputs: GM chocks/aircraft parts; BL tracks, front/back role and camera/aircraft layout.
modules.outputs: One result; all confirmed eligible visits must latch chocked; no visits is Not observed.
modules.attention: A one-time chock latch does not prove continuous chocking throughout the entire parked interval.

modules.title: Cone behind beltloader
modules.inputs: GM cones/doors/aircraft parts; BL tracks and role/view context.
modules.outputs: One result; all confirmed eligible BL visits must be coned.
modules.attention: Checklist and code thresholds differ; preserve code behavior as the migration baseline, then approve requirement changes separately.

modules.title: Staged cones and chocks
modules.inputs: GM cones/chocks and transport/obstacles; aircraft tracks/motion; metadata sufficient for central counting logic.
modules.outputs: Staged-equipment compliance result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: YAML 6/4 counts are not the active main-code 7/6 counts. Do not assume every configuration value controls behavior.

modules.title: Conditioned-air removal and stowage
modules.inputs: Pixels; GM nose/pushback and aircraft motion; full hose history and departure time.
modules.outputs: Combined decision with separate removal/stowage evidence in the internal decision routine and report.
modules.attention: Held boxes are counted repeatedly in current history. Evidence is a visual area/position proxy, not an observed disconnected coupling.

modules.title: Cone removal ordering
modules.inputs: GM wing/engine/tail cones, wheels/aircraft parts and obstacles; BL/aircraft tracks.
modules.outputs: One result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Despite its name it does NOT test whether GSE is chocked, and its equipment coverage is narrower than all GSE. A chocked prerequisite is new functional work.

modules.title: Aircraft cone placement
modules.inputs: GM typed wing/engine/tail cones, aircraft and transport obstacles; camera/aircraft type.
modules.outputs: One policy; normal return also contains counters/stage data (five values versus three on early paths).
modules.attention: Obstacle report text says 40% while code tests 65%; inconsistent return arity requires an explicit legacy adapter.

modules.title: Pre-arrival crew presence
modules.inputs: GM person counts and transport obstacles; aircraft arrival/motion; clip start time.
modules.outputs: One result/report/timeline based on crew exposure in the eligible window.
modules.attention: This measures counts over a window, not continuous presence of the same three named workers for ten minutes.

modules.title: Pre-arrival FOD walk
modules.inputs: Pixels; worker tracks, GM aircraft/front wheel/parts and vehicle detections; approach trajectory.
modules.outputs: One result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Not the simple horizontal-crossing rule in the basic description; bbox-derived scale is not calibrated physical distance.

modules.title: GSE chocks
modules.inputs: Pixels; GSE tracks/motion, GM chocks, persons, BL and occluding transport/objects.
modules.outputs: Per-GSE stop evidence aggregated to module result; failed eligible cases cause failure.
modules.attention: Different chock evidence channels have different semantics; current truthy fusion must be made explicit before sharing.

modules.title: Beltloader hand signals
modules.inputs: Pixels; workers/BL/aircraft tracks, doors and obstacle detections; stop episodes and view/layout.
modules.outputs: One result over observable eligible BL visits; unobservable visits can be omitted when others qualify.
modules.attention: Raised wrists are a coarse gesture proxy, not an approved signal vocabulary. Same HRNet checkpoint as steering does not imply same crop preprocessing.

modules.title: Beltloader handrail use
modules.inputs: Pixels; workers and BL tracks, aircraft/door/engine/wheel context, transport/person occluders.
modules.outputs: Pass when all evaluated climbers have contact plus positive coverage; Fail for a sufficiently covered non-contact case; none evaluated is Not observed.
modules.attention: Whole-body hands are required; do not substitute body-only pose. Unknown climbers are excluded rather than forcing global unknown in current aggregation.

modules.title: Arrival marshaller and wing walkers
modules.inputs: GM aircraft parts/people/obstacles and aircraft/worker tracks; arrival motion.
modules.outputs: One role-position result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: No separate pose/wand model or lead-marshaller signal proof on the active path.

modules.title: Steering-pin verification action
modules.inputs: Pixels; worker/aircraft tracks, nose wheel/pushback/aircraft and obstacles; departure and attachment evidence.
modules.outputs: One verification result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Measures a verification-like worker action, not direct pin visibility. Current 1.5/2.5-second criteria differ from the supplied description.

modules.title: Post-arrival walk-around
modules.inputs: Pixels, workers/BL/aircraft tracks and aircraft-part detections; camera/layout and arrival/loading gates.
modules.outputs: Result, report/timeline and technical evidence (canvases/CSV/JSON).
modules.attention: Post-arrival rescue/outlier options are disabled by default. Score-derived confidence is not demonstrated calibrated probability; required cached geometry must exist.

modules.title: Pre-arrival safety huddle
modules.inputs: Pixels; GM cones and big vehicles, worker/aircraft tracks, cone-relative perspective ROI and arrival observation.
modules.outputs: One huddle result/report/timeline.

modules.title: Pre-departure walk-around
modules.inputs: Pixels; aircraft parts, worker/BL/aircraft tracks; latest loading end, departure evidence and pushback obstruction.
modules.outputs: Result/report/timeline plus technical trajectory/geometry/classifier evidence.

modules.title: Wing walkers at pushback start
modules.inputs: Worker/aircraft tracks, aircraft parts and person/pushback/obstacle detections.
modules.outputs: One readiness result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Current evidence is post-start co-motion, not a direct proof that everyone was ready before start. Global role flags require per-turn state isolation.

modules.title: Pushback pathway clearance
modules.inputs: GM aircraft nose/tail, BL/GSE/fuel truck/trailer/cone/chock/ladder and pushback; aircraft motion.
modules.outputs: One pathway result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Current hazard class list does not include people. Variable pushback_moving uses aircraft state, not an independent pushback motion state.

modules.title: Beltloader rail extension
modules.inputs: Pixels; BL/aircraft tracks, front/back role, camera context and stopped-state evidence.
modules.outputs: One result/report/timeline; no qualified loader is Not observed.
modules.attention: 480 frames is about 60 seconds at 8 FPS, not eight minutes. Shared classifier reuse needs artifact/preprocessing identity.

modules.title: Vest fastening
modules.inputs: Pixels; GM vest/person boxes and worker tracks; no turnaround stage required by the core rule.
modules.outputs: One result; person dictionary nonempty without final unzipped states returns Pass; no associated workers returns Not observed.
modules.attention: No keypoint pose despite the model name. Current unknown/undefined workers can coexist with Pass; do not silently strengthen semantics during extraction.

modules.title: Pre-arrival safety-zone clearance
modules.inputs: Pixels; aircraft/front-wheel/cone detections and approach tracks; transport/person detections and motion masks.
modules.outputs: One result; unknown if uncertain exposure exceeds passing exposure, otherwise Pass absent enough violations.
modules.attention: Upstream tracker does not cover every transport class currently tracked here. FOD and safety-zone ROIs are related but not identical.

modules.title: Steering bypass installation
modules.inputs: Pixels; workers, aircraft/front wheel, obstacles and arrival state; camera-specific wheel ROI.
modules.outputs: One installation result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Distinct learned installation task from heuristic pin verification. Chock detections are collected but do not establish chocking prerequisite.

modules.title: Wing positions and approved wands
modules.inputs: Worker/aircraft tracks, GM aircraft parts/pushback/persons/obstacles and movement history.
modules.outputs: Position result plus wand sub-result and associated report/timeline structures.
modules.attention: CRITICAL semantic gap: approved-wand Pass is hard-coded on the active path. Old wand-count code is not called; merely extracting it would not preserve active behavior or establish correctness.

modules.title: Camera ingestion and full-turn assembly
modules.inputs: Camera chunk manifests/storage/DB, 60-second video chunks nominally 8 FPS, persisted camera/turn candidate state.
modules.outputs: Merged full-turn media plus DB/session metadata and processed-chunk state.
modules.attention: Its coarse capture boundary is not identical to downstream arrival/departure semantics. Keep clip and analytic-stage versions distinct.

modules.title: General-model pipeline
modules.inputs: Merged video/pixels, inference configuration/class mappings, model artifacts and worker metadata writer.
modules.outputs: general_model<video>.ndjson; camera/entity/aircraft type, stage/statistic dictionary, noise and broken-image information.
modules.attention: Airplane height replaces normal detection confidence in the output array. Do not treat every fifth numeric field as probability.

modules.title: Tracking and semantic vehicle state
modules.inputs: Video pixels, GM NDJSON, class mappings, DeepSORT/tracked-object configuration and utility pins.
modules.outputs: trackers<video>.ndjson: Track serialization, vehicle private state_dict, and BL role data.
modules.attention: Only GSE/BL get general vehicle tracking here; downstream safety-zone still tracks other transport. Serialized private fields tightly couple consumers to implementation versions.

modules.title: Shared CV library
modules.inputs: Model/runtime configs, pixels/detections, track state and geometric inputs supplied by callers.
modules.outputs: Python APIs/classes rather than one pipeline stream.
modules.attention: Standalone master is not every module dependency. Missing helper imports at selected pins must be resolved deliberately, not via blanket submodule update.

modules.title: Media, artifact, worker and reporting infrastructure
modules.inputs: Media/storage/DB/Kafka configuration, model and task IDs, weights/inference artifacts and module return values.
modules.outputs: NDJSON, task statuses/reports/timelines, technical artifacts and job execution status.
modules.attention: Replace positional row joins and private filename conventions with explicit identity. Legacy tuple/task-array adapters must preserve multiple results and optional extras.

components.title: Aircraft arrival context
components.contract: Arrival time, whether arrival was seen, and how much pre-arrival footage is available.

components.title: Aircraft departure context
components.contract: Departure time, whether departure was seen, and the available departure footage.

components.title: Aircraft layout
components.contract: Aircraft and part locations, aircraft type and camera view, including missing or off-screen parts.

components.title: Chocks and cones detections
components.contract: Chock and cone locations, types and counts over time. Placement requirements remain in the policy.

components.title: Transport detections
components.contract: Vehicle and ground-equipment locations and classes, including beltloaders, GSE, pushback and ladders.

components.title: People detections
components.contract: Person locations and counts per frame. Counts alone do not establish worker identity.

components.title: Camera obstacle status
components.contract: Which camera regions are blocked or not visible, and when. Keep region-specific visibility rather than one global flag.

components.title: Vehicle movement and stops
components.contract: Vehicle identity, position, direction and moving or stopped periods, with continuity across track changes.

components.title: Beltloader service status
components.contract: Which loader serves each door, its approach and parked periods, and when it leaves or returns.

components.title: Pushback attachment status
components.contract: When pushback appears attached to the aircraft. Current implementations use sustained proximity, not mechanical coupling detection.

components.title: Worker tracks and paths
components.contract: Worker identities and time-stamped positions, directions and paths relative to the aircraft or work area.

components.title: Worker pose
components.contract: Body landmarks and confidence; hand landmarks where needed. Body-only and whole-body models remain separate profiles.

components.title: Workers near equipment
components.contract: Which workers are drivers, helpers, climbers or interacting near a wheel, and during which equipment visit.

components.title: Chock analysis
components.contract: Chock evidence at the relevant wheel over time, with separate nose-wheel, main-gear, beltloader and GSE profiles. Keep direct sightings, worker-action clues and image-change clues distinct; final policy rules stay local.

components.title: Worker actions
components.contract: Time-stamped bending, sitting or raised-hand evidence. These are task-specific action profiles, not an approved signal vocabulary.

components.title: Handrail state
components.contract: Whether rails appear extended and where the rails are. Location masks are only needed by contact checks.

components.title: Handrail contact
components.contract: Whether and when a climber appears to hold the rail, with contact visibility and observation coverage.

components.title: Walk-around evidence
components.contract: Inspection paths, aircraft-relative coverage, model scores and usable observation coverage. Arrival and departure scorers remain distinct profiles.

components.title: Ground work areas
components.contract: The relevant ground region: FOD corridor, safety zone or pushback path. These are different region profiles, not the same polygon.

components.title: Hose state
components.contract: Hose location and deployed or stowed appearance over time. Visual changes do not prove physical disconnection.

components.title: Huddle cone detection
components.contract: The location and identity of the green meeting cone, including its color check.

components.title: Vest closure
components.contract: Each worker's zipped, unzipped or unknown vest appearance, with viewing direction and image quality.

components.title: Pin installation actions
components.contract: Worker action classes and times near the nose wheel from the learned installation model. This does not directly see the pin.

components.title: Wand evidence
components.contract: Visible wands associated with workers. Required by the checklist, but active visual verification is missing in the reviewed module.

components.title: Scene type and image quality
components.contract: Inside or outside scene, image noise and usable image quality, with suitable preprocessing.

components.title: Aircraft movement
components.contract: The main aircraft's identity and moving or stopped history. Capture boundaries and analytical stage rules remain separate profiles.

components.title: Video frames and timing
components.contract: Read video frames with their source identity and timing, including frame access and replay.

components.title: Turn video assembly
components.contract: Find, order and merge camera chunks into a turn video, retain context and resume incomplete processing.

components.title: Metadata exchange
components.contract: Read, align, store and deliver frame metadata through NDJSON or messaging. Current positional joins still need correction.

components.title: Job setup and execution
components.contract: Load configuration and weights, run pipeline stages and modules, and manage artifacts and retries.

components.title: Results and evidence
components.contract: Map task outputs, retain evidence and deliver reports, keeping processing errors separate from compliance failures.

components.title: CV runtime helpers
components.contract: Shared model wrappers and image, box, mask and coordinate operations. These are library internals, not policy inputs.
